out.subject: Complete fastener kit – bundled supply proposal
out.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for your offer of €5.74 per kit. We would like to build on your existing supply relationship by placing the complete kit with Leitner & Sohn, covering both bolt types, the nuts and the washers.

The enclosed term sheet proposes €5.05 per kit, payment at 90 days net and a contract term of 24 months. It includes a binding commitment of 30000 kits a year throughout the term, representing our full kit requirement. Delivery remains DAP with a lead time of 5 days.

You previously indicated that you could take on additional parts and that the additional shift was on hold. Bundling the complete kit gives you a firm basis for planning that capacity, while giving us a single point of contact for the kit.

What price can you offer against this committed volume and the proposed payment and contract terms?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Offer a single bundled package with binding annual volume and a longer contract, linking the commitment to the supplier's stated capacity. Reserve supporting claims for subsequent discussion.

out.subject: Complete fastener kit – revised package and volume basis
out.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for welcoming the complete kit and agreeing to a 24-month term with payment at 90 days net. We would keep that payment arrangement rather than the shorter-payment option.

The revised term sheet proposes €5.17 per kit, 90 days net and 24 months. It includes a binding commitment of 30000 kits a year throughout the term, covering our full kit requirement. We cannot commit to a higher annual volume. Delivery remains DAP with a lead time of 5 days.

For the planning basis you requested, please see the shared forecast figures below for the bolt component. That component forecast supports planning; the annual kit commitment is the volume specified in the term sheet.

I note your comments on cost drivers. Please also weigh the committed complete-kit business when reviewing the price. Can you agree to this revised package?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

out.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for reducing your offer to €5.51 per kit and retaining the agreed payment and contract terms. I understand that the verified bolt price history does not directly change your calculation for the complete kit.

Our binding commitment remains 30000 kits a year throughout the contract, covering our full kit requirement. We cannot commit to a higher annual volume.

For this review, please also see your delivery scorecard figures below. We are proposing consolidation with Leitner & Sohn despite that delivery record because your range and stated capacity to take on additional parts support the complete-kit arrangement.

The revised term sheet proposes €5.28 per kit, payment at 90 days net and a term of 24 months, with DAP delivery and a lead time of 5 days. Regarding your general terms, please confirm that the expressly agreed package terms take precedence over any differing standard terms.

With the annual commitment confirmed, what is your best price for this complete package?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
